Crime & Law · India

Corporator Accused of Assaulting Doctors, Leading to Hospital Staff Strike

A Shiv Sena corporator and others have been accused of assaulting doctors and hospital staff at a Thane hospital. The incident, reportedly captured on CCTV, led to outrage from the medical community and a strike by doctors and nurses in Kalyan-Dombivli. The Maharashtra government has assured action, while the accused corporator has reportedly refused to apologize.
